connector_config.scope_declaration: The WHO GRC-approved guidelines catalogue in full, minus every record whose own catalogue Copyright field declares all rights reserved. Surveyed 2026-08-31 (docs/who-catalogue-survey.md): 358 records, 35 reserved, 323 claimed here. This is a WHO guidelines corpus and should be named as one - the survey found four records mentioning a core internal-medicine condition, so it is not an internal-medicine corpus and must not be described as one. Scope further narrowed by an IRIS pre-flight on 2026-08-31: of 285 claimed, 281 resolve to a downloadable ORIGINAL bundle and 4 do not (2 stale handles, 2 with no IRIS handle at all). The connector raises rather than blocks on a transport 404 during enumeration - deliberately, so a retryable fault cannot silently drop a record the publisher lists - which means one unresolvable item fails the whole job. At 13 hand-checked items that never bit; at 285 it bit immediately. Narrowed again after a dry run of the connector's own enumeration: of 281 items with resolvable handles, 235 expose an English-suffixed PDF in their IRIS ORIGINAL bundle and 46 do not. `allow_unsuffixed_language` stays false - the connector must not guess across languages - so those 46 are out of scope rather than acquired blind.
